items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Billie Holiday had received a $75.00 deposit to play... they needed a group in there... 'We got it. He's right here now, Arnett Cobb.'

ctx.x: because I didn't want to go in it anyway.

The very first job they booked me on -- no, I won't say that, not the very first -- while I'm in the office, get a call from Baby Grand Cafe on 125th. Billie Holiday had received a $75.00 deposit to play 29th and the 30th of April. And she was in Chicago working, and they needed a group in there.

So Ralph said, "We got it. He's right here now, Arnett Cobb." They said, "Good." They had never had anything in there above a trio. I happen to remember the date so well. It's my anniversary date of me and this gal here, our eighth anniversary, 29th of April. We were married the 29th of April, 1939.
